title: Quick Start
subtitle: Draft → validate → save in minutes
description: Create a form, edit the draft, and persist with a mutator.
content: qortex-form owns draft edits and validation. You supply source `data` and a save mutator.

sections.title: 1. Create a form
sections.content: Pass source data (or `initialData`) and optional validation:

sections.title: 2. Edit the draft
sections.content: Overrides are stored per path until save or reset:

code.code:
user.set("name", "Ada");
user.snapshot.isChanged; // true
user.draft?.name;        // "Ada"
user.data?.name;         // original source value

sections.title: 3. Save with a mutator
sections.content: `save` validates, runs your mutator, then `resetDraft` on success. The mutator result is **not** applied as `data` — refresh source via query refetch or `setData`.
